rights_holder: Public domain (Edward Steichen, 1922; first published in the United States)
attribution: Edward Steichen, portrait of Constantin Brâncuși, photographed in Brâncuși's studio in Paris in 1922; first published in the United States. Public domain in the U.S. (PD-US-expired). Via Wikimedia Commons.
subject: Constantin Brâncuși (1876–1957), Romanian sculptor, portrait by Edward Steichen taken in Brâncuși's Paris studio in 1922 — anchors the long Steichen–Brâncuși friendship that would lead to the 1928 Brancusi v. United States customs case. Note: the Wikimedia Commons file page records the location as Brâncuși's studio (Voulangis is mentioned in some catalog metadata as Steichen's home — the studio in this 1922 image is Brâncuși's, in Paris). PD-US-expired status applies for U.S. distribution; EU copyright on the photograph by Steichen (d. 1973) extends to 2043 (life+70).
